name: Halifax Sourced source contract
productIntent: Public Halifax food and drink discovery for events, specials, happy hours, patios, openings, menus, hours, and practical source-linked details.
notInScope: Restaurant quality rankings from restricted third-party review content
principles: Cross-reference public and permitted sources, then keep source links attached to every lead.
Store restaurant-owned facts and source links separately from third-party platform content.
Keep restricted platform records as source references unless the API terms permit display and retention.
Track when each captured fact was observed, where it came from, and whether it needs cross-checking.
Never treat missing data as a negative signal; mark it as missing, stale, restricted, or unverified.
OpenStreetMap directory records are discovery/practical-data records, not editorial quality verification.
Public registry records are establishment/address cross-references, not quality ratings or compliance scores.

scope.starter_area: Halifax peninsula, Dartmouth, Bedford, Armdale, Fairview, and immediately surrounding areas

restaurant.name: Display name
restaurant.neighborhood: Halifax, Dartmouth, Bedford, or local district
restaurant.category: Restaurant | Cafe | Bar | Pub | Quick eats | Food court | Dessert
restaurant.qualityScore: legacy field used as a source coverage score from weighted public/practical source signals
restaurant.freshnessDate: YYYY-MM-DD date when facts were last checked
restaurant.address: Postal address when available from a permitted source
restaurant.phone: Phone number when available from a permitted source
restaurant.website: Restaurant-owned website when available from a permitted source
restaurant.openingHours: Opening hours expression when available from a permitted source

coordinates.lat: Latitude when available from a permitted source
coordinates.lon: Longitude when available from a permitted source

discoverySignals.menu: Official menu or menu keyword/link lead
discoverySignals.specials: Happy hour, daily special, feature, promo, or offer lead
discoverySignals.events: Live music, trivia, event, calendar, ticket, or show lead
discoverySignals.patio: Patio, rooftop, terrace, outdoor seating, beer garden, or sidewalk lead
discoverySignals.openings: Opening soon, now open, grand opening, soft opening, new location, or coming soon lead
discoverySignals.takeout: Takeout, pickup, online order, or delivery lead

inspectionRecords.id: Nova Scotia public registry record id
inspectionRecords.name: Registry establishment name

sources.label: Human-readable source
sources.type: restaurant_site | openstreetmap | google_places | meta_owned_page | review_site | owner_submission | event_feed | ns_food_inspection

officialSiteSignal.signalMatches: Keyword groups found in page text
officialSiteSignal.candidateLinks: Official links whose text or URL indicates menus, specials, events, patios, openings, brunch, reservations, takeout, or delivery

special.title: Happy hour, daily special, tasting menu, or promo

event.title: Event name
event.sourceUrl: Official calendar, ticketing page, or restaurant-owned announcement

constraints: Use browser caching and valid referrers.
Do not bulk download, prefetch, or package public OSM tiles for offline use.
